title: Lightmap bake crashes at indirect light calculation
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta.custom_build [49a004fc1]

### System information

Ubuntu 23.10  - Nvidia 2060

### Issue description

The issue happen when baking the Backyard Distro scene with 0.5 texel density (or higher). VRAM is not a problem in this case. 
As @clayjohn suggested, when reducing `rendering/lightmapping/bake_performance/max_rays_per_pass` and `rendering/lightmapping/bake_performance/region_size` to half, the issue seems to be fixed.


VRAM before the crash:

```
Usage: 4539MiB /  6144MiB
godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64 :    4117MiB
````

### Steps to reproduce

Use the Backyard Bistro Scene
Add a Lightmap node
Set it to 0.5 texel density
